en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an equestrian statue of King Karl IX on a tall pedestal in a city square. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the monument. In the background are multi‑storey European buildings with shop signs, one reading "C. LINDEMA…". Red printed caption text appears below the image, with a short line of publisher information beneath.
